name: Agribio Spirits Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1975, Agribio Spirits Ltd is in the business of manufacturing liquor[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ASL used to be in the business of exporting 
leather, jute, handicrafts, and trading commodities. Currently, it has entered the alcohol manufacturing business

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 3.67 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 8.88% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.15 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.2%
Working capital days have increased from 175 days to 350 days
